placements.why: The content ratifies a binding technical contract about how remember operates as an async, non-blocking design — this is architectural decision-making at the organizational level, naming a category nothing existing covers.
placements.title: Binding technical commitments ratified as system design contracts
placements.frame: What architectural decisions and contracts shape how the system is designed to operate?

placements.title: From blocking calls to async receipt-and-poll
placements.frame: How does the remember contract deliver immediate return without blocking or lost work, and what retrieval paths does it give the caller?
placements.why: Both expressions perform the same binding technical commitment about the async remember contract: src-1 ratifies the terms (receipt in seconds, cursor polling, no blocking, no lost work if receipt dropped), src-2 records the key decision (dispatch, then poll or piggyback reaction on a later call). This is a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding — the async contract design — not a one-time fact.
